svg.title: map-costs
svg.desc: Prefill pays compute that grows with N squared; decode pays bytes that grow with N for every generated token. Llama-3-8B at 128K: attention prefill 4.5 PFLOP versus 2.1 PFLOP for everything else; each decode step reads 16 GiB of KV versus 15 GiB of weights.
